function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

Below is a practical guide to the most popular men’s underwear styles, plus tips on choosing the right one for your body type, lifestyle, and personal preferences. Feel free to let me know if you’d like more detail on any particular style, brand, or material. | Style | What it looks like | Typical fit | Best for | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------------|-------------|----------|------|------| | **Briefs** | Classic “boxy” cut with a waistband that sits at or just below the hips. | Mid‑rise, snug | Everyday wear, office, casual | • Good support
• Wide waistband
• Easy to pair with any pants | • Can feel restrictive
• May show lines under tight pants | | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines briefs and boxers: longer leg coverage, tighter fit. | Mid‑rise, snug | Sports, travel, everyday | • Supports thighs
• Reduces friction
• Versatile | • Can feel hot in summer
• May bunch up under tight jeans | | **Boxers** | Loose, relaxed fit with a waistband that sits at the hips. | Low‑rise (often) | Casual, sleepwear, lounging | • Breathable
• Comfortable for long wear | • Less support
• Can create visible pant lines | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer briefs, similar snugness. | Mid‑rise, snug | Modern look, active wear | • Sleek profile
• Good support
• Less bulk | • Limited leg coverage
• May not suit taller frames | | **Thongs** | Minimal rear coverage, waistband at hips. | Low‑rise | Swimwear, minimal pant lines | • No pant lines
• Lightweight | • Not for everyone
• Can cause irritation | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive waistband with a pouch; minimal fabric. | Low‑rise | Athletic, performance | • Excellent support
• Breathable | • Very minimal coverage
• Not for everyday | | **Compression Underwear** | Tight, elasticized fabric; often includes a gusset. | Low‑rise | Recovery, high‑intensity training | • Improves circulation
• Reduces muscle vibration | • Can feel restrictive
• Requires proper sizing | | **Seamless / Micro‑fiber** | No seams, ultra‑smooth fabric. | Varies | High‑performance, travel | • No chafing
• Lightweight | • May lack durability
• Limited color options | | **Eco‑friendly / Sustainable** | Made from bamboo, hemp, recycled polyester. | Varies | Eco‑conscious shoppers | • Biodegradable
• Often soft | • Can be pricier
• Limited availability | --- ### How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Body Type & Height** * **Tall / Long‑legged** – Boxers or trunks with a higher rise keep the waistband from riding up. * **Short / Compact** – Boxer briefs or briefs with a lower rise prevent the waistband from digging into the hips. * **Muscular / Broad Shoulders** – Look for styles with a wider waistband or gusset for better support. 2. **Activity Level** * **Everyday / Office** – Boxer briefs or briefs offer a good balance of support and comfort. * **Sports / Training** – Compression underwear or boxer briefs with a gusset reduce friction and improve blood flow. * **Travel / Long Flights** – Seamless or micro‑fiber underwear prevents chafing during long periods of sitting. 3. **Fabric Preferences** * **Cotton** – Soft, breathable, but may absorb sweat. * **Modal / Bamboo** – Moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly, and silky. * **Micro‑fiber / Polyester blends** – Durable, quick‑dry, and often cheaper. * **Spandex / Elastane** – Adds stretch for a snug fit. 4. **Fit & Comfort** * **Waistband** – A wide, flat waistband reduces pressure points. * **Gusset** – A gusseted pouch offers extra ventilation and support. * **Seamless** – Eliminates chafing, especially for active wear. 5. **Style & Fashion** * Plain colors (black, navy, gray) are versatile. * Printed or patterned underwear can add personality but may show through tight pants. * Consider a “no‑pant‑line” cut if you’re wearing slim or skinny jeans. 6. **Sustainability** * Bamboo, hemp, or recycled polyester are great eco‑friendly choices. * Look for certifications like GOTS (organic) or OEKO‑Tex (non‑toxic). 7. **Price & Value** * **Budget** – Brands like Hanes, Fruit of the Loom, or Target’s own labels offer decent quality. * **Mid‑range** – Calvin Klein, Jockey, or Under Armour provide a mix of style and durability. * **Premium** – Lululemon, Tommy John, or Saxx focus on advanced fabrics and ergonomic design. 8. **Sizing Tips** * Use the brand’s size chart; sizes can vary between manufacturers. * For a snug fit, choose the same size as your regular briefs. * For a looser fit, go up half a size. --- ### Quick Reference: “Which Style for Which Situation?” | Situation | Recommended Style | Why | |-----------|-------------------|-----| | **Daily office wear** | Boxer briefs or briefs | Supportive, no pant lines | | **Running / HIIT** | Compression underwear | Reduces muscle vibration | | **Long flights** | Seamless or micro‑fiber | Prevents chafing | | **Summer beach** | Thongs or swim‑specific jockstrap | Minimal coverage, stays dry | | **Nighttime / Sleep** | Loose boxers or breathable modal | Comfort & airflow | | **Fashion statement** | Printed boxer briefs or trunks | Adds flair without compromising fit | --- ### Final Checklist Before You Buy - [ ] Identify your primary use (daily, sports, travel). - [ ] Check the brand’s sizing chart. - [ ] Decide on fabric preference (cotton vs. performance blend). - [ ] Choose a waistband style (flat, wide, or gusseted). - [ ] Look for reviews on fit, durability, and comfort. - [ ] Compare prices across brands and retailers. Happy shopping! If you’d like brand recommendations for a specific style or material, just let me know.
